package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var ErrTeacherSoulNotFound = errors.New("teacher soul not found")

const (
	DefaultTeacherSoulDisplayName        = "Mentor"
	DefaultTeacherSoulPersonaCode        = "patient_mentor"
	DefaultTeacherSoulVoiceStyle         = "clear_supportive"
	DefaultTeacherSoulRelationshipStyle  = "respectful_collaborative"
	DefaultTeacherSoulEncouragementStyle = "evidence_based"
)

// TeacherSoul is the durable per-student identity and relational style of one
// logical PersonalTeacher. It never contains student learning state or history.
type TeacherSoul struct {
	PersonalTeacherID  string    `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	StudentID          string    `json:"student_id"`
	DisplayName        string    `json:"display_name"`
	PersonaCode        string    `json:"persona_code"`
	VoiceStyle         string    `json:"voice_style"`
	RelationshipStyle  string    `json:"relationship_style"`
	EncouragementStyle string    `json:"encouragement_style"`
	Version            int64     `json:"version"`
	CreatedAt          time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt          time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type TeacherSoulSettings struct {
	DisplayName        string `json:"display_name"`
	PersonaCode        string `json:"persona_code"`
	VoiceStyle         string `json:"voice_style"`
	RelationshipStyle  string `json:"relationship_style"`
	EncouragementStyle string `json:"encouragement_style"`
}

func DefaultTeacherSoulSettings() TeacherSoulSettings {
	return TeacherSoulSettings{
		DisplayName:        DefaultTeacherSoulDisplayName,
		PersonaCode:        DefaultTeacherSoulPersonaCode,
		VoiceStyle:         DefaultTeacherSoulVoiceStyle,
		RelationshipStyle:  DefaultTeacherSoulRelationshipStyle,
		EncouragementStyle: DefaultTeacherSoulEncouragementStyle,
	}
}

func NewTeacherSoul(
	personalTeacherID string,
	studentID string,
	settings TeacherSoulSettings,
	now time.Time,
) (TeacherSoul, error) {
	personalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(personalTeacherID)
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	settings = normalizeTeacherSoulSettings(settings)
	if !validUUID(personalTeacherID) || studentID == "" || !validTeacherSoulSettings(settings) || now.IsZero() {
		return TeacherSoul{}, errors.New("invalid teacher soul")
	}
	now = now.UTC()
	return TeacherSoul{
		PersonalTeacherID: personalTeacherID, StudentID: studentID,
		DisplayName: settings.DisplayName, PersonaCode: settings.PersonaCode,
		VoiceStyle: settings.VoiceStyle, RelationshipStyle: settings.RelationshipStyle,
		EncouragementStyle: settings.EncouragementStyle, Version: 1,
		CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	}, nil
}

func (soul TeacherSoul) Settings() TeacherSoulSettings {
	return TeacherSoulSettings{
		DisplayName: soul.DisplayName, PersonaCode: soul.PersonaCode,
		VoiceStyle: soul.VoiceStyle, RelationshipStyle: soul.RelationshipStyle,
		EncouragementStyle: soul.EncouragementStyle,
	}
}

func (soul *TeacherSoul) UpdateSettings(settings TeacherSoulSettings, expectedVersion int64, now time.Time) error {
	if soul == nil || expectedVersion <= 0 || soul.Version != expectedVersion {
		return ErrVersionConflict
	}
	settings = normalizeTeacherSoulSettings(settings)
	if !validTeacherSoulSettings(settings) || now.IsZero() {
		return errors.New("invalid teacher soul settings")
	}
	soul.DisplayName = settings.DisplayName
	soul.PersonaCode = settings.PersonaCode
	soul.VoiceStyle = settings.VoiceStyle
	soul.RelationshipStyle = settings.RelationshipStyle
	soul.EncouragementStyle = settings.EncouragementStyle
	soul.Version++
	soul.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	return nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherSoul(input TeacherSoul) (TeacherSoul, error) {
	settings := normalizeTeacherSoulSettings(input.Settings())
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.DisplayName = settings.DisplayName
	input.PersonaCode = settings.PersonaCode
	input.VoiceStyle = settings.VoiceStyle
	input.RelationshipStyle = settings.RelationshipStyle
	input.EncouragementStyle = settings.EncouragementStyle
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || input.StudentID == "" || !validTeacherSoulSettings(settings) ||
		input.Version < 1 || input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return TeacherSoul{}, errors.New("invalid teacher soul")
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeTeacherSoulSettings(settings TeacherSoulSettings) TeacherSoulSettings {
	settings.DisplayName = strings.TrimSpace(settings.DisplayName)
	settings.PersonaCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.PersonaCode))
	settings.VoiceStyle = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.VoiceStyle))
	settings.RelationshipStyle = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.RelationshipStyle))
	settings.EncouragementStyle = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.EncouragementStyle))
	return settings
}

func validTeacherSoulSettings(settings TeacherSoulSettings) bool {
	return validValue(settings.DisplayName, 80) && validValue(settings.PersonaCode, 64) &&
		validValue(settings.VoiceStyle, 64) && validValue(settings.RelationshipStyle, 64) &&
		validValue(settings.EncouragementStyle, 64)
}
